A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.6.30;
son of: Shimea (H8092);
father of: Asaiah (H6222I)
§ Haggiah = "festival of Jehovah"
son of Shimea and a Merarite Levite

H2294.def:
A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.3.4; married to David (H1732);
mother of: Adonijah (H0138)
§ Haggith = "festive"
a wife of David and mother of Adonijah

H2295.def:
A woman of the tribe of Manasseh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.26.33;
daughter of: Zelophehad (H6765);
sister of: Mahlah (H4244), Noah (H5270), Milcah (H4435H) and Tirzah (H8656)
§ Hoglah = "partridge"
3rd of 5 daughters of Zelophehad, a descendant of Manasseh

H2296.def:
1) to gird, gird on, gird oneself, put on a belt
1a)(Qal)
1a1) to gird
1a2) to gird on, bind on
1a3) to gird oneself

H2297.def:
one (number), same, single, first, each, once
Aramaic equivalent: chad (חַד "one" H2298)
